# has notation projection profile

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile`](gmeow-hasNotationProjectionProfile.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasNotationProjectionProfile>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a notation system to its GMEOW projection profile. Non-functional: a future notation system may have co-existing profiles for different consumer contexts.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) -> [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile`](gmeow-hasNotationProjectionProfile.md) from [`gmeow:NotationSystem`](../classes/gmeow-NotationSystem.md) to [`gmeow:NotationProjectionProfile`](../classes/gmeow-NotationProjectionProfile.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use from a notation system to reach its projection profile(s) — the notation-rooted inverse of [`gmeow:notationSystemOf`](gmeow-notationSystemOf.md), natural when traversing from the surface form to its loss ledger.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it directly when [`gmeow:notationSystemOf`](gmeow-notationSystemOf.md) is the natural direction (assert that and read this as its inverse) and avoid assuming a single profile — different consumer contexts may carry co-existing profiles.

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:notationSystemOf`](gmeow-notationSystemOf.md) on the profile and reading [`gmeow:hasNotationProjectionProfile`](gmeow-hasNotationProjectionProfile.md) as its inverse; reach for it explicitly only in notation-rooted traversals.
